items.exampleEn: Utilities such as water and electricity are included in the rent.
items.exampleZh: 水電等公用事業費用已經包含在房租裡。
items.glossZh: 公用事業（水電瓦斯）；實用性

items.exampleEn: The ticket inspector asked to see our train tickets.
items.exampleZh: 查票員要求看我們的火車票。

items.exampleEn: The company makes components for electric cars.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司生產電動車的零件。

items.exampleEn: The manufacturer recalled thousands of phones with a battery problem.
items.exampleZh: 那家廠商召回了好幾千支電池有問題的手機。

items.exampleEn: She has worked in manufacturing for most of her life.
items.exampleZh: 她大半輩子都在製造業工作。

items.exampleEn: The farm's output of rice fell because of the dry weather.
items.exampleZh: 因為天氣乾燥，那座農場的稻米產量下降了。

items.exampleEn: The old mill by the river once made flour for the whole village.
items.exampleZh: 河邊那座老磨坊以前為全村磨麵粉。

items.sentenceEn: The factory's output rose by twenty percent after it bought new machines.
items.sentenceZh: 那家工廠買了新機器後，產量增加了百分之二十。

items.audioEn: A building inspector will come on Tuesday to check our new house.
items.audioZh: 星期二會有一位建築檢查員來檢查我們的新房子。
items.questionZh: 檢查員星期二要做什麼？
options: Build a new house next door

items.sentenceEn: This car manufacturer builds most of its cars in Mexico.
items.sentenceZh: 這家汽車製造商大部分的車都在墨西哥生產。

items.sentenceEn: Manufacturing is still an important part of the town's economy.
items.sentenceZh: 製造業仍然是這個小鎮經濟的重要部分。

items.stemEn: One small ____ was missing, so the machine would not start.
items.stemZh: 少了一個小零件，所以機器無法啟動。

items.stemEn: The writer's ____ is amazing: more than eighty books in forty years.
items.stemZh: 那位作家的產量驚人：四十年寫了八十多本書。

items.passageEn: For over a century, the paper mill was the biggest employer in our town. Forty years ago, its output was so large that trains carried paper from the town every day. Later, the mill was bought by a large manufacturer from Japan. The new owners replaced the old machines with modern ones made of high-quality components. The mill's manager first came to the town as a young inspector who checked the quality of its paper. Because manufacturing needs a lot of water and power, utility bills are the mill's biggest cost. Some people wanted to sell the land to real estate companies, but the town decided to keep the mill and the jobs it brings.
items.passageZh: 一百多年來，這座紙廠一直是我們鎮上最大的僱主。四十年前，它的產量大到每天都有火車把紙運出鎮外。後來，紙廠被一家日本的大型製造商買下。新老闆把舊機器換成用高品質零件做成的新式機器。紙廠的經理當年是以年輕檢查員的身分來到鎮上，負責檢查紙的品質。因為製造業需要大量的水和電，水電等公用事業費用是紙廠最大的開銷。有些人想把土地賣給房地產公司，但鎮上決定保留紙廠和它帶來的工作機會。

items.promptZh: 我叔叔當了二十年的警察督察。
referenceEn: My uncle has been a police inspector for twenty years.
My uncle worked as a police inspector for twenty years.
rubricZh: 「督察」可寫，例如 inspector、police inspector 等
時態合理（例如 has been、worked 等）

referenceEn: All the toys from this manufacturer are made of wood.
This manufacturer makes all of its toys from wood.
rubricZh: 「製造商」可寫，例如 manufacturer 等
